title: Expired Signing Secret
content:
Purpose: Expired Signing Secret.

Technical details: Webhook signature verification failed after a secret rotation because a consumer retained the previous signing secret. Delivery attempts were rejected despite valid payloads.

Operational guidance: The team synchronized secrets, verified signatures, and added a rotation checklist.

Investigation evidence: Record affected services, timestamps, correlation identifiers, observed behavior, expected behavior, recent changes, and reproducible diagnostic steps.

Verification: Compare outcomes against documented requirements. Do not claim a root cause without supporting evidence. Document unresolved uncertainty and recommended follow-up.
